change: adds the exact string 'Connection error.' to the enumerated benign-transient set
evidence: 4 occurrences on the 2026-08-07 main run, across Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.3-70B batch_verdict calls, while 503s and [Errno 104] connection resets were occurring on the same endpoints in the same window.
note: Append-only. Grants no authority and changes no cap.
what_it_does_not_relax: nothing. The same-call limit, the uncertain-spend ceiling and the resume backstop are unchanged. This amendment only names one more shape of the condition the policy already treats as benign.
why_benign: It is the SDK's generic wrapper for a transport-layer failure with no HTTP response: the same class as 'Connection reset by peer' and 'Connection aborted', already enumerated, just without a specific errno. Like every member of the set it may have billed server-side, which is exactly what the permanently-counted uncertain reservation and the uncertain ceiling bound.
why_this_is_not_a_widening: Anchored to the exact SDK string with ^...$ rather than matched loosely. A pattern that absorbed anything mentioning a connection would quietly swallow real anomalies, and a test asserts that 'connection refused: authentication failed' still stops the run.
